title: oekaki roles
description: What roles exist here and what each one may do. Who holds a role is not in this file: that changes while the system runs and is kept with the rest of the state.

roles.description: Role name to what it says about each permission.

anonymous.description: The roles a caller who has not signed in holds.

allowWithoutRepoRead.description: Whether to show a drawing to someone the identity provider says cannot read the repository it came from. Doing so is a way around that repository's own access control, so it has to be asked for.
